findings.failure_scenario: A machine whose node file is the documented older name, <monorepo>/.maind.json or <package>/.maind.json, has no config.json and no ~/.maind. install.sh only checks $CFG_ROOT/config.json and ~/.maind, so it mkdir's <state>/maind and copies configs/registry.example.json to registry.json. Config.load then takes source "config" from that example (projects brain, swissknifeman, maind) and does not read the legacy file's registry. The live fleet is replaced by the sample without a warning. The same script's comment and docs/guide/installation.md say nothing is created when a legacy node file already exists.
findings.reproduction: Read-only: install.sh:117-120 versus Env.legacy_node_config (common.py:87-93) and load_config (config.py:590-596). Not executed; the installer writes state.

triage_reproduction.cmd: emulate the install.sh:117 guard with a temp CFG_ROOT holding only .maind.json, no config.json, no ~/.maind, no registry.json
triage_reproduction.observed: guard `! -f config.json && ! -d ~/.maind` is true, so install.sh would copy registry.example.json to registry.json; the legacy .maind.json is not checked. Env.legacy_node_config (common.py:87-93) does treat .maind.json as a source.

findings.failure_scenario: No registry.json, legacy config.json (or .maind.json) exists — the live layout until upgrade. maind projects sync, onboard, or Config.save calls write_registry, which takes the legacy branch and atomic_write_json's the whole node document. Unlike the registry.json branch (projects.py:146-148), this path never calls aicore.state.backup. A bad registry update replaces the only copy of the node file; nothing is left under .swissknifeman/backups or the state backups directory. The writer contract requires a backup before replacing the existing file, and docs/guide/config.md states that the previous file is kept.
findings.reproduction: Read-only: write_registry lines 130-131 call _write_legacy_registry, which writes at line 170 with no backup. test_save_writes_the_legacy_document_only does not assert a backup. Not executed.

triage_reproduction.observed: the only backup() call is at projects.py:147, in the registry.json branch. _write_legacy_registry (:152-172) calls atomic_write_json(env.legacy_node_config, ...) with no backup.
